title: TTZipErrorInfo
description: C-ABI structured error envelope for cross-language error propagation

code.description: TTZipStatus negative error code (or 0 for OK)

domain.description: Error domain (1: Archive, 2: Crypto, 3: VFS, 4: FFI, 5: System)

source_file.description: Source filename where error was created

line_number.description: Line number where error was created
